items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: Actually, Monk, I consider it quite a challenge to do that... You know? I still get something out of it.

ctx.x: Like what you need to do at the Savoy.

Basically yes. Yes, that’s right. And I don’t stray too far because in that context people don’t necessarily know what’s going on. You played the song but then you just went off somewhere and did something else, but then you came back and played the song again. Actually, Monk, I consider it quite a challenge to do that, to keep playing, without the advantage of, like you’re going to play one tune and take seven choruses. So you have to do more material and you have to maybe consider other ways of rendering a…
What made you switch from accordion to piano?
